EPISODE_NARRATIVE: A warm front lifting slowly northward across Connecticut and into Massachusetts helped trigger a few marginally severe thunderstorms in western and central Massachusetts in the early afternoon.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: In Worcester, flooding was reported on Whipple Street at Blackstone River Road with manhole covers floating.  Also, flooding was reported on College Street at Southbridge Street.
